changelog:
## v1.9.33

- Bundle Badge Show/Hide & Corner Ribbon: Added toggle to hide/show bundle selected badge, removed default box-shadow, added full styling, and added Top-Right corner rotated ribbon style
- Checkout Section Header: Added dedicated title and description header before checkout form with default Bengali text ('অর্ডার করুন' / 'অর্ডার করতে নিচের ফর্মটি সঠিক ভাবে পূরণ করুন...')
- Checkout Section Styling: Added comprehensive container styling for the entire checkout section including background, border, border-radius, padding, margin, box-shadow, and divider line
